title: numeric block props
description: A question answered with a number, accepted within a tolerance, with targeted feedback for the values learners get with typical errors. Either reuse a validated numeric question of the plan (questionRef) or write it inline.
x-ai-instructions: Use it for calculation objectives (apply level) instead of multiple choice. Put the unit in unit. Give correct and incorrect feedback, and one misconception per typical error (wrong formula, inverted ratio, sign error) with feedback naming that error. Tolerance: absolute for rounded values, percent for measured ones.

questionRef.description: Id of a numeric question of the plan. When set, do not set stem, answer, tolerance, unit, feedback or misconceptions.

unit.description: Unit shown after the input, for example rpm.

objective.description: Plan objective measured. Taken from the plan question when questionRef is used.

attempts.description: Tries before the answer is final.

showCorrectAnswer.description: After the last try, show the expected value.
